subject: Dedicated capacity discovery recap - LumenHealth
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@lumenhealth.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity fit discussion / LumenHealth

Rafael / Aditya,

Thanks again for taking the time today - really helpful conversation. As promised, a short recap from our side so we have alignment going into the technical deep-dive next week.

Key pain points we discussed:
- Latency spikes during peak hours (especially when batch ETL jobs kick off) causing SLAs with our care partners to be missed.
- Unpredictable throughput on our current shared clusters; occasional preemption of GPUs causes job failures.
- Regulatory concerns: most inference touches PHI and we need strict network isolation and customer-managed keys.

Current stack:
- Internal on-prem GPU cluster (mix of p3/p4 equivalents) managed by infra team; spot/ephemeral instances used for cost control.
- Models: custom fine-tuned T5-style + open-source encoder models for embeddings; currently running 8-bit quantization with bits-and-bytes.
- Orchestration: Airflow for batch jobs; Kubernetes for online endpoints.

Success criteria for a Dedicated solution:
1) Predictable throughput: sustained 200 qps for embedding requests, ability to burst to ~600 qps for nightly ETL windows.
2) Isolation & compliance: VPC-level isolation, customer KMS integration, SOC2 evidence.
3) Pricing predictability: committed monthly cost with clear overage rules.

Requested next steps:
- Please share any NDA/Sec questionnaires and SOC2 evidence upfront.
- Proposal for a Dedicated config (reserved GPU pool sizing, autoscale/burst behaviour, A/B pricing for trial vs committed).
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with our infra leads (Elliot and Priya) next Tue/Wed morning PT.

I've attached a short requirements doc and a simple network diagram.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Head of ML Engineering, LumenHealth
priya@lumenhealth.com

Attachments: lumen_requirements.pdf, lumen_network_diagram.png

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity fit discussion / LumenHealth

Hi Priya - great to meet you and thanks for the clear recap. Re-summarizing on our side and capturing the immediate action items so we're aligned: 

Summary of needs (short):
- Stable, reserved GPU pools to avoid preemption and to hit your sustained throughput SLOs.
- Autoscale/burst to handle nightly ETL spikes without manual intervention.
- VPC/private deployment with KMS integration and audit logs for PHI compliance.

Initial sizing idea (ballpark, for discussion on tech call):
- Baseline: 2 x A100-class GPUs reserved (capacity for sustained embedding throughput ~200 qps given your model family and quantization profile).
- Burst/ETL window: autoscale up to 4 x A100 for short periods (configurable burst policy with warm-fast spin-up).
- Persistent KV-prefix cache and batching options to reduce per-token cost for high-throughput embedding workloads.

Open questions we need from your infra team before deep-dive:
1) Typical request size (avg tokens) for embeddings and largest batch sizes currently used.
2) SLA target for 95th/99th latency percentiles.
3) Any egress/network restrictions (IP allowlist, peering constraints).

What we'll send before the call:
- Draft Dedicated proposal (config + pricing bands + trial options).
- SOC2 summary and security package link.
- Suggested agenda for the tech deep-dive.

Proposed times for the deep-dive: Tue 8/31 9:30 - 10:30 PT or Wed 9/1 10:00 - 11:00 PT - let me know which works for Elliot/Priya.

I'll attach the draft proposal and security packet in a follow-up email once I confirm with our pricing team.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

- SLA targets: 95th < 150ms for online embeddings; ETL batch windows can be slightly looser but need guaranteed completion within nightly window.
- Network: we require VPC peering and static egress IPs for partner allowlists; KMS integration is mandatory.

Elliot (cc) will join the tech call and bring our infra owner Dave Kim if needed. We'll review your draft proposal ahead of the meeting.

Priya
